problem_statement: The Megakit startup-template-html-website-megakit-004 project is a static multi-page marketing template (Corporate/index, About, Team, Services, Events, FAQ, Contacts) with a shared overlay navigation, a mobile menu trigger, portfolio assets, a contact form, and a Services page that hosts a 'Finding your Plan' pricing section with three tiers (Individual, Team, Enterprise). Today the pricing shows only monthly prices with no way to compare annual billing, and the pricing block lives only on Services. Extend the existing static site with a native 'Choose your billing' Monthly/Annual toggle above the plan cards that rewrites the plan prices and a live readout, and surface the same pricing block on the Corporate home and About pages, while preserving the original Megakit navigation, mobile menu, portfolio assets, contact form, and unrelated pages.
required_content: Keep the implementation in the existing static HTML/JS architecture; do not add a framework, router, build system, backend, or external service.

Add a 'Choose your billing' segmented Monthly/Annual toggle (buttons and a live readout) directly above the three Finding-your-Plan cards on the Services page, styled with the existing Megakit utility classes.
Add a small local js/plan-billing.js that, on toggle, rewrites each plan card price from its data-monthly/data-annual value and updates the readout text live from the currently selected billing.
Monthly (default) must show exact visible text Billing: Monthly and the readout Individual from $39/mo with card prices 39, 59, 79.
After clicking Annual, the readout must update to exact visible text Billing: Annual and Individual from $31/mo with card prices 31, 47, 63.

Surface the same pricing block (the 'Choose your billing' toggle plus the three plan cards) on the Corporate home page (index.html) and the About page (about.html) so the plan story is continuous across the marketing site.

Preserve original visible content including Megakit, Corporate, App Landing, Portfolio, Events, About, Team, Services, FAQ, Contacts, Finding your Plan, Individual, Team, Enterprise, Signup, Contact Us, and Frequently Asked Questions.
design_constraints: The billing toggle and pricing block must look like native Megakit marketing content: uppercase eyebrow labels, primary accent (#4a90d9-family blue), rounded pill controls, centered card width, generous vertical spacing, and the same Lato/Montserrat typography and s-plan-v1 card treatment.
Do not replace the header, overlay navigation, mobile menu trigger, service plan cards, contact form, footer, portfolio grid, or page-level hero sections.
Do not edit vendor libraries, minified framework files, or remote links except for adding the local plan-billing script and stylesheet includes.
Desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile captures must avoid new horizontal overflow: the billing toggle bar and the plan card row must wrap and fit inside the phone viewport (overflow tolerance 24px).

change_completion: The Services Finding-your-Plan section gains a Monthly/Annual billing toggle whose default Monthly state shows prices 39/59/79 and the readout 'Billing: Monthly · Individual from $39/mo'.
Clicking Annual updates every plan price to 31/47/63 and the readout to 'Billing: Annual · Individual from $31/mo' via local static JavaScript.
design_consistency: The new billing toggle uses Megakit's existing primary accent, uppercase eyebrow, rounded pill controls, and centered card layout.
Original Services cards, Contacts form, header, overlay nav, footer, and multi-page marketing style remain recognizable across index, about, and services.
regression: Unrelated About, Team, FAQ, Corporate, portfolio assets, footer, form fields, and nav labels remain present.
The patch does not introduce a backend, remote service, dependency, vendor rewrite, or replacement app shell.
responsive: The billing toggle bar and plan card row render without new horizontal overflow at desktop, tablet, and 390px mobile widths.
The mobile menu trigger still opens the original overlay navigation after the cross-page pricing extension.

state_constraints: The initial states (desktop/tablet/mobile) capture the Services page scrolled to top; the services_plan states scroll the #plan-billing toggle bar and the three plan cards into frame.
desktop_services_annual is desktop_services_plan after a real click on the Annual billing toggle; the readout must change to 'Billing: Annual'.
desktop_index_plan and desktop_about_plan capture the same pricing block surfaced on the Corporate home and About pages for cross-page continuity.
author_notes: Repo-grounded static multi-page Megakit marketing task (Vijay-Ky startup-template-html-website-megakit-004) hardened to L4 with a native pricing billing toggle. The reference mounts a 'Choose your billing' Monthly/Annual segmented control above the existing Finding your Plan cards, wires live price + readout recompute in js/plan-billing.js, and surfaces the pricing block on index and about. Visual design keywords: layout, color contrast, typography, spacing, responsive mobile wrap, card grid, logo/image assets. The bad negative control is a real geometry break (overlapping shingled cards on a dark slab with near-white illegible price and title text and a buried toggle bar), not a recolor, verified against the reference screenshot.
